upstream.description: M3U Playlist for free TV channels

classification.analysis: This repository maintains a curated, community-sourced M3U8 playlist of free, legal-to-stream TV channels from around the world, organized by country in per-country markdown files and compiled into a single playlist via a Python script. It targets IPTV app users who want a ready-made channel list rather than software to build with, and enforces a strict quality bar (HD only, one URL per channel, no paid or geoblocked-only content). It is very actively maintained with automated CI to validate and rebuild the playlist.

use_cases.title: Point an IPTV player at a maintained free-TV playlist by country
Contribute a new free, legal streaming channel via pull request
